en.headline: Eleven injured after private car and green minibus collide in Tuen Mun
en.dek: The crash on Castle Peak Road near Tun Fu Road late on Monday left both drivers and nine passengers with minor injuries; a section of the road was temporarily closed.
body: A private car and a green public light bus collided on Castle Peak Road – Lingnan section near Tun Fu Road in Tuen Mun at about 9.51 p.m. on Monday, police said.

Eleven people were hurt. The 74-year-old minibus driver and the 26-year-old private-car driver reported injuries to the legs and waist. Nine passengers – three men and five women aged 21 to 78 on the minibus, plus a 54-year-old woman in the private car – sustained minor injuries. All were conscious and taken to Tuen Mun Hospital.

The private car’s front end was heavily damaged and its windscreen shattered; the minibus also suffered front-end damage. Officers spread sawdust on leaked fuel. Castle Peak Road towards Yuen Long near Tun Fu Road was fully closed for a time, causing congestion. Police are investigating the cause.

zh.headline: 屯門青山公路私家車與專線小巴相撞 11人輕傷
zh.dek: 周一晚近10時青山公路嶺南段近屯富路兩車相撞，兩名司機及九名乘客受傷，全部清醒送屯門醫院，一段道路一度全封。
body: 警方表示，周一晚上約9時51分，一輛專線小巴沿青山公路嶺南段往富泰邨方向行駛，一輛私家車沿相反方向駛至，於右轉入屯富路期間與小巴相撞。
事件中11人受傷。74歲姓謝小巴男司機及26歲姓楊私家車男司機分別報稱腳部及腰部疼痛；小巴上3男5女乘客（21至78歲）及私家車上54歲女子均報稱輕傷，全部清醒，由救護車送往屯門醫院治理。
私家車車頭嚴重凹陷，擋風玻璃碎裂，小巴車頭亦有損毀。警員在漏油位置灑上木糠清理。青山公路嶺南段往元朗方向近屯富路一度全線封閉，交通繁忙。意外原因仍在調查。
